description.zh: 指定要申请运维的资产账户登录名。
description.en: The logon name of the asset account for the O\&M request.

description.zh:
需要申请运维的资产ID。
> 您可以调用[ListOperationDatabases](~~2758856~~)和[ListOperationHosts](~~2758857~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the asset for which to request O\&M.

> Call the [ListOperationDatabases](~~2758856~~) and [ListOperationHosts](~~2758857~~) operations to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
申请登录的有效期结束时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
> 申请登录的有效期结束时间需要晚于申请登录的有效期开始时间
description.en:
The end time of the validity period for the logon request. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh: 申请登录的有效期开始时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
description.en: The start time of the validity period for the logon request. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
申请登录次数。取值：
- **true**：在有效期内仅登录一次。
- **false**：在有效期内不限制登录次数。
description.en:
Specifies whether the ticket is valid for a single logon. Valid values:

- **true**: The ticket is valid for a single logon.

- **false**: The ticket is valid for multiple logons within the validity period.

description.zh:
指定要申请运维的协议名称。取值：
- SSH
- RDP
- MySQL
- PostgreSQL
- Oracle
- SQLServer
description.en:
The name of the protocol for the O\&M request. Valid values:

- SSH

- RDP

- MySQL

- PostgreSQL

- Oracle

- SQLServer

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about regions and zones, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 创建运维申请（仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用）

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-operation-ticket --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --asset-id 2 --protocol-name SSH --asset-account-name root --is-one-time-effect false --effect-start-time 1685600242 --effect-end-time 1679393152 --approve-comment Comment --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateOperationTicket --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolName SSH --EffectStartTime 1685600242 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --IsOneTimeEffect false --ApproveComment Comment --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AssetAccountName root --EffectEndTime 1679393152 --AssetId 2
